==Walkthrough==
===Getting started===
{{Needed|recommended=[[Teleportation]] methods to [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]] and [[Yanille]].}}
{{Checklist|
*Speak to [[King Narnode Shareen|King Shareen]] in the [[Grand Tree]] with two empty slots to receive a [[translation book]] and a [[bark sample]]. {{Chat option|1You seem worried, what's up?|1I'd be happy to help!}}
*Talk to [[Hazelmere]] in his house on the island east of [[Yanille]] ([[fairy ring]] code: {{Fairycode|CLS}}). He will take your bark sample and give you a [[Hazelmere's scroll|message]] for the king.
}}

===Glough===
{{Map|x=2477|y=3463|r=3|width=250|height=250|mtype=square|align=right|caption=Glough's house location.}}
{{Checklist|
*Return to [[King Narnode Shareen|King Shareen]]. He will ask what the message says. Tell him: {{Chat option|1I think so.|5None of the above.|5None of the above.|2A man came to me with the King's seal.|1I gave the man Daconia rocks.|4And Daconia rocks will kill the tree!}}
*Head south. At the bottom of the incline, turn east and go up the ladder to speak with [[Glough]].
}}

===Investigation===
{{Needed|1000 [[coins]] (if you haven't helped [[Femi]]).|recommended=A [[teleport]] out of [[Karamja]].}}
{{Checklist|*Return to [[King Narnode Shareen|King Shareen]], and he will tell you that [[Glough]] has caught a human. Ask to see the prisoner.
*Talk to the prisoner [[Charlie (prisoner)|Charlie]] on the top floor of the Grand Tree. '''Make sure to finish the entire conversation!'''
*Go to Glough's house. Search the [[cupboard (The Grand Tree)|cupboard]], and you will find his [[Glough's journal|journal]].
*Talk to Glough and wait to be arrested.
*Talk to Charlie; he will tell you about the [[Ship Yard|shipyard]] on [[Karamja]]; the password is '''Ka-Lu-Min'''.
*[[King Narnode Shareen|The king]] appears and tells you to escape using the [[gnome glider]] on top of the tree.
*Travel with the glider.}}

===Karamja===
{{Checklist|
*The glider will crash near the [[Ship Yard]]. Run east past the level 53 [[jogre]]s to the Ship Yard gate.
*Open the gate and tell the [[Shipyard worker|worker]] Glough sent you, then give the password '''Ka-Lu-Min'''. {{Chat option|2Glough sent me.|1Ka.|2Lu.|2Min.}}
*Find the [[Foreman]] on the southern dock. Kill him or talk to him to get a [[lumber order]].
**If you talk to him, he will ask you some security questions. {{Chat option|3Sadly his wife is no longer with us!|2He loves worm holes.|1Anita.}}
*Take the lumber order to [[King Narnode Shareen|the king]]. (Teleport into the stronghold or get [[Femi]] to sneak you in, costing 1,000 coins if you didn't help her earlier). The king will not believe you when you show him the lumber order.
}}

===Tuzo===
{{Map|x=2391|y=3511|r=3|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=Anita's house on the map.|mtype=square}}
{{Needed|[[Lumber order]].}}
{{Checklist|
*Speak to [[Charlie (prisoner)|Charlie]] again on the top floor of the [[Grand Tree]].
*Speak to [[Anita]] up the stairs west of the swamp, north-west of the Grand Tree. She will give you a [[Glough's key|key]]. {{Chat option|1}}
*Go to Glough's house, and use the key to open the chest and take the [[invasion plans]]. '''Make sure to complete the dialogue window to receive the plans!'''
*Take the invasion plans to the king. He will give you four letters made of sticks (you'll need 4 empty inventory spaces).
*Climb the watchtower in Glough's house (tree in the east part of his house). Use the sticks with the four pillars to spell out '''TUZO'''. If you are under 25 [[Agility]], eat your [[summer pie]] now.
*Bank if needed and prepare for the battle, then go down the trapdoor.
}}

===Encountering the Black demon===
{{Needed|[[Combat]] [[Worn equipment|equipment]] and [[food]] to last in a fight against a level 172 [[Black demon (The Grand Tree)|black demon]].}}
[[File:Black demon (The Grand Tree, 1) safespot.png|thumb|Recommended safespot, located directly north of the entrance ladder.]]

{{Checklist|
*After you enter and talk to Glough, a level 172 [[Black demon (The Grand Tree)|black demon]] will appear and attack you.
**Immediately after the cutscene ends, run to the tile directly north of the ladder. The black demon will become stuck behind the daconia rocks in front of you as he approaches. Attack with [[ranged]], [[magic]], or a [[halberd]].
**'''Warning:''' The demon will despawn after a while if it is not killed within 10 minutes exactly. If this happens, you'll have to exit through the ladder in the centre of the cave and go through Glough's trapdoor again.
*Kill the demon. Walk along the passage until you find [[King Narnode Shareen|King Shareen]] standing by a ladder.
*Talk to the king, and he will ask you to locate the last [[daconia rock]]. ''Fully complete the dialogue; otherwise, you cannot continue.''
*Search the [[Root (The Grand Tree)|roots]] until you find it (make sure to click continue on the dialogue when you find the stone).
*Talk to the king one last time.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
